turns.user: I'm taking a bus to the airport; does my ordinary single ticket work?
turns.agent:
It depends which airport bus you mean. Your ordinary single ticket does not work on the 100E Airport Express. It does work on 200E under ordinary ticket rules; the 100E-specific ticket or add-on does not cover 200E. These are facts from the limited 5 November 2026 snapshot, not a live check. See BKK’s Single ticket, Airport shuttle bus single ticket and Airport Express pages.

Which route are you taking—100E or 200E? If it’s 100E, tell me what exact pass you have, if any, and I can explain the supported fare options.

Yes—an ordinary single ticket is valid on 200E under the ordinary ticket rules, according to the 5 November 2026 snapshot. It is not valid on 100E. See BKK’s Single ticket and Airport Express pages for the applicable rules; I haven’t live-verified current policy.
